title: Caliper reading units and checks before use
objective: Distinguish the source’s reading and display increments, and explain why jaw gaps and zero indication are checked separately.
activity: On paper, list the three vernier reading increments separately from the digital display increment. Explain why checking gaps and play is separate from checking the zero indication.
safety: Study on paper. Before adjusting or measuring with an actual instrument, check the specified instrument’s specifications and approved procedures.
summary: Distinguish the source’s reading and display increments from the actual instrument’s specifications. Check physical gaps against the light separately from zero indication; setting the display to 0 alone does not establish that an abnormal condition has been resolved.

paragraphs.title: The source’s values and the actual instrument
paragraphs.text: The source lists vernier reading increments of 0.1 mm, 0.05 mm and 0.02 mm, describing 0.05 mm as commonly used. It states a digital display increment of 0.01 mm. These are descriptions in this source; do not apply the same values to every instrument. Check the actual instrument’s specifications. Display fineness alone does not establish measurement accuracy or suitability for judging a tolerance.

paragraphs.title: Check for a gap against the light
paragraphs.text: The source’s preparation instructions include wiping the measuring and sliding surfaces and checking that the slider moves smoothly without play. It also describes closing the slider and holding the jaws against the light to check for a gap. Keep this way of checking a physical gap distinct from checking the numerical zero indication.

paragraphs.title: A zero display alone does not mean preparation is complete
paragraphs.text: The source describes checking whether the closed instrument indicates 0 and explains that a digital instrument can be set to 0 with its zero-reset button. Setting the display to 0 is separate from checking gaps or play. Do not infer that pressing the button to hide an abnormal condition is acceptable. For an actual instrument, follow its specifications and approved checks, and report abnormalities.

terms.reading: さいしょうひょうじりょう
terms.meaning: The smallest unit shown by a digital display.
In this lesson, the 0 indication checked with the instrument closed.
